statistics: median and nearest-rank p95; retain all raw samples including failures
conditions: Real Rx, My Timber and HQ domains; same release; UK broadband and a recorded mobile connection; cold and warm caches; Chromium and WebKit; physical iPhone/PWA and Android wrapper parity checks separately
exclusions: Time a person takes to type credentials, complete MFA/passkey or decide a clinical outcome is excluded. Supplier waiting time is reported separately and never counted as a confirmed local success.
failureRule: Any missing sample, functional error, duplicate side effect, hidden stale state or failed percentile fails that action. Local synthetic timings do not pass hosted or physical-device acceptance.
